messages.content: Can I return a broken item after 2 weeks?

documents.title: Returns policy
documents.text: Broken items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund.

message.content:
Whether you can return a broken item after two weeks depends on **where you bought it**, **why it is broken**, and the **store's specific policy**.

Here is a breakdown of your options based on the most common scenarios:

### 1. If the item arrived broken or failed due to a defect (Manufacturer Defect)
If the item stopped working on its own or arrived damaged, you are usually protected regardless of the 14-day window.
